topic.source_contract: healthcare demand, ICB planning, primary-care capacity, developer contributions, funding and delivery

scope_guards: Population growth is not treated as a quantified healthcare impact without scheme and demographic inputs.
A national funding allocation is not treated as site-specific healthcare mitigation.
A draft request or heads of terms is not treated as an executed section 106 obligation.
CIL availability is not treated as ring-fenced or spent healthcare funding.
Existing floorspace is not treated as available clinical capacity without workforce and utilisation evidence.
Land identification is not treated as transferred and serviced healthcare land.
A paid contribution is not treated as an opened and operational service.
No score or promotion is written without exact demand, capacity, obligation, funding, land, programme and operational evidence.
